title: StudyFlow data file (data.json)
description: Everything one user creates. Written by the app; schemaVersion 2. Images are standalone records that subjects and study points list by id (many-to-many).

images.description: All pictures of this user. A picture can be listed by many subjects and study points.

id.description: Random UUID (uuid4) as 32 lowercase hex characters.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC with a +00:00 offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:30:00+00:00.

nullableTimestamp.description: A timestamp or null. Written as a type list rather than an either-or schema so error messages stay readable.

imageIds.description: FKs to Image.id: the images shown here, in the order they were added. The same image may be listed by many subjects and study points. Every id must exist in the top-level images list (checked by the app; JSON Schema cannot check it).

points.description: Study points of this subject (one subject has many points).

effortHours.description: Optional estimated study effort. null means not estimated.

Image.description: A standalone picture record. It has no owner; subjects and study points list it by id.

file.description: Path of the picture relative to the data folder. The picture itself is not stored in the JSON.

tags.description: Lower-case, trimmed, unique, sorted. Many-to-many with images (a tag is just a string).
